column2: [intro]
In life, don’t take it too seriously,
We don’t mind if things are a bit tacky,
Sequins and glitter aren’t our style,
We prefer simple things that make us smile.
Cause we’re cheap, cheap, cheap,
We embrace life without the bling-bling,
Cheap, cheap, cheap,
And that’s what makes us happy, it makes us swing.
We don’t need all that fancy stuff,
To shine bright, crystal isn’t enough,
A smile, warm hands, that's much better,
Let’s make love, not money, let’s dance together.
Cause we’re cheap, cheap, cheap,
We embrace life without the bling-bling,
Cheap, cheap, cheap,
And that’s what makes us happy, it makes us swing.
[ solo ]
So forget the luxury and the pretense,
Come into our world, join the dance,
Cause we’re cheap, and proud to be so,
Together, we’ll make this planet glow.
[outro]
